decisions.reason: Q1 contains 'acoustics', the first word of the label 'Acoustics Guild'.
decisions.suggested_fix: Reword Q1, e.g. 'What organization was formed after the Cactus Sonata concert to study the sound qualities of natural environments?' (avoid the word acoustics).

decisions.reason: Q1 uses 'fields' (and 'desert') from the label 'Arizona cactus fields' and is oddly phrased ('What were the vast desert fields...').
decisions.suggested_fix: Reword Q1 to ask 'Where was the Cactus Sonata concert performed?' with the vast desert-setting hint but no 'fields'.

decisions.reason: Q2 'named guild' contains 'guild', part of the label 'The Acoustics Guild'.
decisions.suggested_fix: Use 'organization' or 'group' wording in both questions.

decisions.suggested_fix: Reword Q2, e.g. 'What aspect of the Cactus Sonata's natural setting, related to sound, inspired the Acoustics Guild?' without distinctive/unique.
